university-of-arizona-mathematics-phd.fundingDetail: Conditional on an eligible GA appointment: central 2026–27 minimum at 0.5 FTE is USD 25,654 for a nine-month academic appointment (USD 33,350 fiscal appointment); prorated for appointment length/FTE. At 0.5 FTE or above, 100% base-tuition remission; below 0.5 FTE, 50%. GAs of any residency are billed resident-equivalent tuition. Single-student Campus Health premium covered during appointment, not mandatory/course/program fees. Degree-seeking status and GPA at least 3.0 required. No mathematics-specific multiyear stipend or guaranteed appointment established.
